23043: Creating front ports in bulk with a ranged name (Port [25-36]) failed validation: the form compared the total front port positions against the selected rear positions incorrectly for ranged creation, rejecting a valid mapping.
22990: Bulk edit forms were declared inconsistently across models: module bay template Position was missing from the bulk editor entirely, and nullable fields such as data source ignore rules offered no Set Null control, so values could be neither edited nor cleared in bulk.
22985: Synced data file contents were served without cache exemption, so sensitive file content rendered in the browser could persist in the browser cache after the user navigated away.
22922: The handle_location_site_change() signal handler wrote through the default database connection instead of the active one, breaking installations where a router (such as netbox-branching) directs writes to a branch schema.
22812: Deleting a script with thousands of dependent job and history records loaded the full dependency set into memory, spiking usage to multiple gigabytes and in some cases crashing the instance.
22745: The scripts REST endpoint allowed DELETE, PUT and PATCH for users holding only the view permission and for read-only API tokens: an authorisation gap between the declared permission model and the viewset.
22852: Scripts executed via event rules ignored the script's notifications_default setting, so notification behaviour differed depending on whether a script was run manually or by a rule.
22588: With a prefix scoped to a site group, the form accepted any VLAN rather than restricting choices to VLAN groups whose scope matched the site group, so out-of-scope VLANs could be assigned.
22682: Deleting a site group cascade-deleted prefixes scoped to the group's member sites: silent data loss triggered by removing what the user understood to be only a grouping object.
22644: Mapping a front port to a rear port left no trace in the changelog: the object change records carried no port mapping data and no separate change entry was created.
22578: The REST API returned other users' private saved filters and table configurations, including their stored parameters, even though the UI enforces shared/owner visibility: the restriction lived in the UI layer only.
22429: Object permissions granting token creation under a constraint (for example, only for non-superusers) were silently bypassed in the REST API: a permitted user could create a token for any account, including superusers.
22273: Creating an application service with a large port range (roughly 2,000 ports and up) failed with a database OperationalError instead of either succeeding or returning a proper validation message.
22237: Opening the standalone Add Table Configuration page directly, without arriving through a table's save button, produced a server error because the form assumed table context that was absent.
22324: The GraphQL filter for a choice set's extra_choices used a flat array lookup against what is a nested array field, so the filter shape the API advertised produced errors when used.
22301: Two plugins defining models with the same name, both taggable, collided on the Tag model's reverse manager names at startup: the namespacing that Django app separation should provide did not apply.
22228: VLANGroup.save() computed VLAN ID totals with a formula valid only for canonical half-open ranges: legitimate bounds variants miscounted silently and singleton ranges produced a hard server error.
21498: A regression made event rules on interfaces fail with server errors when a cable's termination was edited, breaking event-driven automation on cabling changes.
20474: Installing a module using placeholder values failed in nested module bay trees: the placeholder resolution counted positions across the tree incorrectly, so valid nested installs were rejected.
21763: The site edit page failed to load when a site had a very large number of ASNs assigned (about 10,000), because the form rendered the full relation instead of constraining the widget.
21129: RQ jobs enqueued to non-default queues survived deletion of their database Job record and re-inserted themselves, so cancelling or re-scheduling a job did not reliably remove the queued work.
20670: Device type bulk import skipped data type validation on component definitions, accepting a scalar where a list was required without a proper validation error, and importing malformed component data.
20389: Bulk rename honoured the current page only: with 'select all objects matching query' checked, objects beyond the visible page were left untouched despite the selection claiming the full query.
18900: The REST API paginator accepted unordered querysets, whose pagination is nondeterministic (objects can repeat or vanish across pages); the fix makes the paginator raise on unordered input.
19806: JobRunner offered no supported way for a job's run() method to mark the job as failed: whatever status the job set was overwritten with completed, so failure states could not be recorded.
